cap_lift_note: Owner ruling 2026-10-14: the lift is capped at 1.0 — nobody rises for survival; the charge on thin-evidence players stands and the lens totals fall by it. Measured: MEASURED_TABLES_F1.txt.

design_notes.age: the engine's integer age at the base season: max(Y - birth_year, 18 + (Y - cycle_year)) (rl_model._age_at); at application the board row's age(p) at AGE_REF = 2026
design_notes.application: RELATIVE within a cohort by EVIDENCE, CAPPED: vP_k' = round(vP_k x min(1, S_k(age_i, g_i) / R_k(age_i))) over the CHARGED rows (games >= 1); R_k(age_i) = sum_j w_j S_k(age_i, g_j) over the charged rows j of the cohort, w_j = vP_j / sum vP — the cohort's evidence mix priced at the row's OWN age, so a row is charged for thinner evidence, never for being older than its cohort-mates (for a single-age cohort this is the value-weighted mean of S_k). Cohorts: one per integer age, ages >= 33 pooled into one, and any age with fewer than 5 charged rows joins the nearest larger cohort below it. The cap means the lens totals can only fall: NOT sum-preserving.
design_notes.bands: career-games bands; the reference band is 1-5 games; dummies for 6-20, 21-50, 51-100, 101+
design_notes.games: career games through the base season (fit: cumulative scoring games <= Y; application: the board row's games)
design_notes.monotone_in_evidence: S(age,g) = min over band midpoints m >= g of S_raw(age,m), together with S_raw(age,g); for g > 180, S_raw(age,g)
design_notes.zero_games: NOT fitted and NOT charged. A never-played retiree's exit season is not observable before the 2024/2025 list facts (575 of the 619 never-played retirees carry no list fact), and a 0-game band in the fit leaked into the shared age slopes (first F1 fit: young_slope -0.309 vs -0.419 played-only for S1). At application a 0-game row carries charged=false, S1/S2 = null, m = 1: its vP is a pick-curve expectation that already averages over busts. The fact-only window's raw rates are recorded in zero_game_fact_window for the record only.

fit.model: additive-logit per lens (IRLS, ridge 1e-6); S1 = P(listed at the end of Y+1), S2 = P(listed at the end of Y+2)
fit.proxy_note: DIRECTION OF BIAS: the last-played proxy UNDER-STATES listing — of the 170 retirees that carry both a list fact and games, 33 were listed one season beyond their last game and 9 two seasons (about 25%). Where the proxy stands (every pre-2024 exit without a list fact) a retiree is counted as exited one season early, so the pre-2024 played-band survival is biased DOWN and the within-cohort charge biased UP, by an unquantified amount. The fit with and without the proxy rows: docs/evidence/engine_survival_hazard_2026-10-14/MEASURED_TABLES_F1.txt.

outcome: S_k(age, evidence) = P(on an AFL list at the END of season Y+k | listed at the END of base season Y with career games >= 1, age at Y, career games through Y), k in {1,2}; PLAYED rows only. last_listed_year per store row = _last_listed (a list fact, the AFL 2024/2025 list changes) when present; else 2026 for a row active today (the live board); else the last season with a game (a PROXY that under-states listing for a retiree who sat out his last listed season(s)). Listed at the end of Y iff debut <= Y <= last_listed_year (debut = draft year + 1; MSD = the draft year). outcome_k = 1 iff last_listed_year >= Y+k. Base seasons 2010..2024 (k=1) and 2010..2023 (k=2): the latest outcome year is 2025, covered by the couriered list changes; nothing depends on an unobserved future. 0-game (never-played) records are not in the fit and carry no fitted S.
ruling_text: D-H = H2: retirement/exit risk on the +1 and +2 lens values is probability-based survival, spread across each age cohort by risk; the lift is capped at 1.0 (owner ruling 2026-10-14), so the lens totals fall by the within-cohort thin-evidence charge.

zero_game_fact_window.note: raw rates for the record; the 0-game outcome is not observable before the 2024/2025 list facts, so no S is fitted or published for 0-game rows
zero_game_fact_window.window: Y=2024, k=1 (listed at the end of 2025 | 0 career games through 2024)
